newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle off $1 at $111/dressed-private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle off $1 at $111/dressed-private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle sold at $111.00 per cwt on a dressed basis in light to moderate volume Tuesday morning, down $1.00 from the bulk of last week's trade, market sources said.

About 6,000 head had sold, although about 1,000 were early at $110.00 for lighter-wieght calves and below the quality of cattle sold later at $111.00 and also below those sold last week mostly at $112.00, sources said.
Further bids at $111.000 were passed by owners asking $112.00 to $113.00. There were no reported bids or sales on a live basis, with asking levels at $70.00 at $71.00.
